info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Adjustment Management API
info.description: The Credit Adjustment Management API facilitates updates to existing credit records within the trade banking domain. This endpoint allows for adjustments to key credit parameters based on evolving business needs or customer requests. Typical consumers include banking professionals and automated systems responsible for credit management workflows. It ensures that credit data remains accurate and up-to-date, thereby enhancing financial decision-making and customer service.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the client to update the details of a specific credit management resource identified by its unique RES-100045 identifier. The patch operation will modify only the fields that are provided in the request body, allowing for partial updates to the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update credit management details for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the provided data structure adheres to the defined schema for a successful update.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
